Name: Torti the Tortilla
Author: sugarsbt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nzBT9dE.png[/img]﻿
Torti the Tortilla is a very cute tortilla living in the Saloon. He will be sure to be awesome, and tell you lots of tortilla puns!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y2OnFoS.png[/img]
Torti has dialogue, gift tastes (consisting of tortillas!), a schedule, and most of all, his very cute portraits and 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sNBk8TS.png[/img]
*These aren't guaranteed, but I would LOVE to add them in the future!*

[list]
[*]Heart events
[*]A lil dance
[*]Festival attending
[*]More schedules
[*]More dialogue
[*]More puns
[*]More tortillas
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wjmfKAm.png[/img]﻿Thank you all that made tortilla mods, inspiring this mod! Thank you HuskyN1nja in modded-farmers for a lot of the puns!
